title: Marguerite and the Alibi
author: Ansel Voss
blurb: Yara Yarrow, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
